controls.label: Arrows
controls.note: Where the arrows that move the gallery sit. They only show when there are more photographs than fit.

top.label: Above, at the right
top.note: Two round arrows above the photographs at the right, where people expect them; on a phone they sit under the row. The default.

edges.label: Over the sides
edges.note: Two round arrows over the left and right of the photographs, halfway down, on a solid circle so they stay clear over any picture.

phone.label: Arrows on a phone
phone.note: Whether a phone shows the arrows too. Either way a visitor can swipe the row.

arrows.label: Show them
arrows.note: The arrows under the photographs on a phone as well. The default.

swipe.label: Swipe only
swipe.note: No arrows on a phone: the next photograph peeking in at the edge says the row goes on. Tidier, for visitors used to swiping.
